title: BEE_CHECK_ONLY name filter in the shared check() helper
action: PROBLEM (user-raised, measured): a cell touching one handler still pays a 346-check suite because a suite is all-or-nothing. Under the feature-verify law MAIN runs the suites, so the cost lands on the boundary run and on every fix-cell re-verify. FIX: add a name-pattern filter to the shared helper `check()` in scripts/lib/test-fixture.mjs (31 suites import it): when process.env.BEE_CHECK_ONLY is set, a check whose NAME does not match runs no body and is counted as skipped, not passed; matching is a case-insensitive substring by default, and a value wrapped in slashes (/re/) is treated as a regex. The summary line reports skips explicitly — e.g. 'N passed, M failed, K skipped (BEE_CHECK_ONLY=...)' — so a filtered run can never be mistaken for a full one, and a filtered run with ZERO matches exits non-zero with a typed message (a filter that matches nothing is a mistake, never a green). Unfiltered behavior must be byte-identical: no env var, no skip counter, same output as today. Also export the filter predicate so suites with their own local check() (22 of them) can adopt it later — do NOT convert them in this cell. Then document it in one line where the verify commands are described (scripts/lib/test-fixture.mjs header comment is enough). R82: run NO test suites — MAIN verifies at close. GIT SAFETY (shared checkout): commit through your own temp index (GIT_INDEX_FILE + read-tree/update-index/write-tree/commit-tree/update-ref) or `git add -N` then a path-scoped commit; NEVER plain `git add`, NEVER reset/stash/checkout/restore.

truths: With BEE_CHECK_ONLY unset, every suite importing the helper behaves byte-identically to today (same counts, same summary line).
With BEE_CHECK_ONLY set to a substring, only matching checks execute; non-matching are counted as skipped and named in the summary.
A /regex/ value is honoured; a filter matching zero checks exits non-zero with a typed message.
The predicate is exported for later adoption by suites with a local check().
prohibitions: Do NOT change any suite's assertions.
Do NOT convert the 22 suites with a local check() in this cell.
Do NOT let a filtered run report itself as a full pass.
Do NOT run any test suite (R82).

regen_obligation_ack: wave-barrier: regen owned by MAIN at feature close (parallel-default D2)

trace.outcome: Added BEE_CHECK_ONLY name-pattern filter (substring or /regex/) to the shared check() helper in scripts/lib/test-fixture.mjs: non-matching checks are skipped and named in the summary, zero matches is a typed non-zero exit, unfiltered behavior is byte-identical, and checkOnlyPredicate is exported for the 22 suites with local check() to adopt later (not converted in this cell).
